purpose: Field-level source and fallback policy for truthful Indian listed-equity data coverage.

coverage_policy.identity_key: ISIN plus exchange security identifier and effective dates
coverage_policy.market_data_freshness_rule: Preserve trade timestamp and label delayed, EOD, stale, or no-trade status explicitly.
coverage_policy.fundamental_basis_rule: Never mix standalone and consolidated facts, periods, units, revisions, or taxonomy families silently.
coverage_policy.adjusted_price_rule: Store exchange raw close and total-return-adjusted close as distinct series with separate provenance.

coverage_notes: The 5103 union is a lower bound for securities traded on one date, not the complete listed-company universe.
SEBI exchange counts overlap and must not be added to estimate a unique national total.
Model eligibility is not interchangeable with page-data completeness.

accepted_autonomous_snapshot.limitations: BSE rows are same-day traded STK securities, not a complete BSE listing master. Classification, broad BSE history and strict audited-standalone fundamentals are not fabricated outside verified coverage. One NSE security has no validated current or recent fallback quote.

field_routes.merge_rule: Build an effective-dated ISIN-security alias graph. A symbol is never a durable key and no fuzzy company substitution is allowed.
field_routes.coverage_target: Measure against unique active and suspended listed ISINs after union ingestion; do not infer from exchange count sums.

field_routes.merge_rule: Prefer the primary listing exchange, cross-check by ISIN, and expose each exchange quote separately when both exist. Latest-on-or-before fallback preserves actual date and staleness.
field_routes.coverage_target: Current observed NSE same-day 99.83%; truthful latest-trade coverage should approach all securities with trading history after measurement.

field_routes.merge_rule: Never splice symbols without an effective-dated ISIN/corporate-event bridge. Resample weekly/monthly from verified daily data.
field_routes.coverage_target: TBD after all-exchange ingestion; 750/750 targeted NSE Yahoo histories were available but do not establish official-history coverage.

field_routes.merge_rule: Keep raw, split-adjusted, and total-return series distinct. Provider adjustment semantics and action coverage must be recorded; complex reorganisations require adjudication.
field_routes.coverage_target: No honest percentage until every series passes action and listing-boundary audit.

field_routes.merge_rule: Cross-validate simple events; preserve issuer scheme and predecessor/successor securities for mergers/demergers. Conflicts stop adjustment.
field_routes.coverage_target: TBD event-level recall; completeness cannot be inferred from a blank endpoint.

field_routes.merge_rule: Store provider taxonomy and version; translate only through an explicit versioned crosswalk. Company business activity is not silently promoted to an NSE sector.
field_routes.coverage_target: Raise current 31.29% NSE coverage toward NSE's stated all-listed classification; BSE-only coverage remains to be measured.

field_routes.merge_rule: Use the same date for price and share count; distinguish issued, paid-up, outstanding and free-float shares. Size bucket is taxonomy/date-specific, not a permanent company attribute.
field_routes.coverage_target: TBD; current index-derived size coverage is 750/2397 and must not label all remaining names small-cap.

field_routes.merge_rule: Select by period_end then filing/available_date, preserve revisions, taxonomy, unit, duration/instant context and standalone/consolidated basis. Derivations require separately versioned definitions.
field_routes.coverage_target: Broad display coverage is realistic; exact normalized ratio/model-input coverage is lower and must be measured per taxonomy/fact.

field_routes.merge_rule: Do not change the accepted V2 contract. A derived ratio from raw facts is a new methodology and cannot silently replace an explicit disclosed ratio. Banks/insurers receive not-applicable/model-contract status where concepts are unsuitable.
field_routes.coverage_target: Current accepted live V2 eligibility is 34/2397; more page facts can be shown without claiming V2 eligibility.

field_routes.merge_rule: Preserve quarter, category taxonomy, denominator, revisions and filing timestamp; do not compare changed categories without crosswalk.
Hash the exact document; extract with Arelle for XBRL and document_extractors for PDFs; every accepted PDF fact retains page, table, label, period, unit and review status.
field_routes.coverage_target: TBD; extraction success is separate from document availability.

field_routes.merge_rule: Use only data whose available_date is on or before ranking_date; preserve later revisions separately. Historical membership is not reconstructed from today's universe.
field_routes.coverage_target: Measured per ranking date; no global percentage is scientifically meaningful.

failure_classes.resolution: Use listing date from official master; display available current data and exact history shortfall; never backfill predecessor data without a legal security bridge.
Resolve effective-dated aliases through ISIN and exchange change files; URL-encode punctuation; retain old symbol provenance.
Use scheme documents and corporate-action ledger; treat successor/predecessor and distributed securities explicitly; unresolved history remains excluded.
Resolve BSE scrip code from official master, use BSE UDiFF/history/filings, and do not invent an NSE ticker.
One issuer/security identity can have separate exchange listings; expose both quotes, choose a documented primary listing for a model, and never average prices.
Use encoded exact symbol plus ISIN, never stripping ampersands, hyphens or punctuation.
Fall back to latest official trade, display its date and staleness; do not call it current for the snapshot date.
Report the impossible horizon and listing date; compute shorter descriptive metrics only when clearly distinct from model requirements.
Fetch official Basic Industry and map with the versioned official hierarchy; do not call all non-index names small-cap or infer sector from a name.
Try XBRL/iXBRL, alternate exchange copy, issuer PDF, OCR/table extraction, then MCA; retain exact stage-specific failure.
Use taxonomy-specific statements and regulatory metrics; conventional ROCE or leverage may be not applicable and cannot be replaced silently.
Cross-check official actions and issuer scheme; quarantine total-return calculations until identity/action chain is defensible.
Separate internal research cache from publicly displayable data; show source link/derived non-substitutive metric only when licensed.
